title: 联合国世界跨信仰和谐周闭幕庆典
title_en: UN World Interfaith Harmony Week Closing Ceremony
body: 2026年2月28日，美国阳翥道教协会会长吉法新率团出席于纽约举行的"联合国世界跨信仰和谐周（World Interfaith Harmony Week）"系列闭幕庆典活动。作为首个且唯一受邀参与该平台活动的道教代表组织，美国阳翥道教协会在国际跨信仰舞台上发出道教声音，展示中华传统文化的智慧与精神内涵。本次活动汇聚多国外交代表，包括委内瑞拉外交官、纽约州议员、纽约市第105分局负责人，以及多位联合国体系相关官员、联合国宗教NGO委员会（CCUN）领导代表出席支持。现场还包括来自多个国际跨信仰组织的代表与领袖，共同参与对话与交流。美国阳翥道教协会以"道法自然、和而不同"为核心理念，积极参与国际跨宗教合作与文明对话，促进不同信仰之间的理解与互信，推动道教文化在国际社会中的传播与认知。
body_en: On February 28, 2026, President Ji Faxin led a delegation from the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America to attend the closing ceremony of the United Nations World Interfaith Harmony Week held in New York. As the first and only Taoist representative organization invited to participate in this platform, the Association voiced Taoist perspectives on the international interfaith stage, showcasing the wisdom and spiritual essence of Chinese traditional culture. The event gathered diplomatic representatives from multiple countries, including Venezuelan diplomats, New York State legislators, the head of NYPD's 105th Precinct, and officials from UN-affiliated bodies and the Committee of Religious NGOs at the United Nations (CCUN). Representatives and leaders from multiple international interfaith organizations also attended to participate in dialogue and exchange. Guided by the core Taoist principles of 'following the way of nature' and 'harmony in diversity,' the Association actively participates in international interfaith cooperation and civilizational dialogue, promoting mutual understanding and trust between different faiths, and advancing the spread and recognition of Taoist culture in the international community.
